Diamond.Mimicry.title: Diamond Mimicry
Diamond.Mimicry.description: You have obtained the power to convert your tissue into a diamond-like substance

first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with eop:dna_capsule{fortress:"eop_true",display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Diamond Mimicry","color":"aqua","italic":false},{"text":" DNA Capsule","italic":false}]'}}
execute if predicate eop:crazy_ghost run give @s diamond

commands: execute if score @s Diamond.Shards matches 100.. run scoreboard players set @s Diamond.Shards 100

Diamond.Barrier.Unlock.title: Diamond Barrier
Diamond.Barrier.Unlock.description: Surround yourself in a diamond barrier, protecting you and anyone directly around you

commands: execute unless entity @s[tag=IsDev] run particle eop:diamond ~ ~1 ~ 0.3 0.3 0.3 1 300 force
execute if entity @s[tag=IsDev] run particle eop:diamond_green ~ ~1 ~ 0.3 0.3 0.3 1 300 force
